definitions.explanation: An emphatic reflexive pronoun that stresses the person themselves, as opposed to others. Combines {自分|じぶん} (self) with {自身|じしん} (itself) for emphasis.

examples.japanese: {自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
{自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's also important to acknowledge your own weaknesses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧にし⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Before worrying about others, take care of yourself first.

notes:
An emphatic form of ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ that explicitly stresses "oneself" as opposed to others. Used when the contrast between self and others needs to be highlighted, or when emphasizing personal agency and responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe in oneself
- {自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to look at oneself; to reflect on oneself
- {自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: one's own problem
- {自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: for one's own sake
- {自分自身|じぶんじしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change oneself

USAGE:
While ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ alone can mean "oneself," adding ⟦{自身|じしん}→自身：30345_jishin⟧ makes it more emphatic and deliberate. This form is common in self-help contexts, speeches, and serious discussions about personal growth. It functions like English "yourself" vs. "your own self" — the longer form carries more weight.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧: plain "self" — less emphatic, used in everyday speech
- ⟦{自身|じしん}→自身：30345_jishin⟧: "oneself" — can attach to other pronouns too (⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦{自身|じしん}→自身：30345_jishin⟧, ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦{自身|じしん}→自身：30345_jishin⟧)
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧: "self" — more formal and abstract, used in compounds like ⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧ (self-introduction)
